name: Marina Fernández Fernández-Campoamor
headline: Bringing Data, AI and Energy Networks together
major: B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering and M.Sc. in Mechanic Engineering
summary: Marina Fernández Fernández-Campoamor is an Team Lead in Data & AI in Energy Networks at E.ON Digital Technology, driving digital innovation in grid modernization. She also co-founded @ysi_energy, a communication platform dedicated to disseminating original and rigorously documented content in the energy sector, simplifying complex concepts, and fostering critical thinking to combat misinformation. Previously, she worked at Coreso, leading key projects in the coordination of Europe's electricity. Marina holds a master's in industrial engineering from UPM and TUM, and an honors degree in technology management from CDTM in Munich. She's passionate about building smarter, more resilient energy systems through data and AI and spreading knowledge about the energy sector.
